verdict.rationale: Zulip's search docs describe a wide array of search filters that can be combined with keywords. These include a channel filter (channel:design has:image ...) and channels:public, which searches across all public and web-public channels, so the core of filtered history search is documented. One older community comment says search 'barely works', but it is vague and is not a concrete counter-example, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of sender and date filters, admin-specific search over private history, and independent hands-on corroboration that search works well.
